articles.title: They Burned Scrolls on Purpose — And It Could Unlock a Roman Library
articles.summary: A researcher burned scrolls on purpose to crack a 2,000-year-old puzzle. If ancient ink contains lead, X-rays can read the words without unrolling the fragile papyrus.

articles.title: NASA's PRIMA Telescope Will Hunt for What JWST Can't See
articles.summary: NASA's new PRIMA telescope will scan far-infrared light — wavelengths JWST can't detect. Launching as early as 2033, it will study how planets, galaxies, and black holes form.

articles.title: A Dead Star Is Producing a Shock Wave That Shouldn't Exist
articles.summary: Astronomers spotted a dead star creating a huge bow shock in space — but it has no gas disc to power it. The discovery challenges what we know about how stars interact with their surroundings.
